products.name: Lilac Doodle Opal
products.description: A dreamy mix of milky nude and lilac shimmer nails scattered with iridescent opal foil and delicate hand-drawn black line art — tiny stars, squiggles, and a single heart. Playful yet refined, this set feels like wearable doodle-pop art on short, rounded tips.

products.name: Confetti Color Blobs
products.description: A playful matte white canvas scattered with hand-painted bursts of red, yellow, green, and deep navy in soft abstract shapes. Each oval nail feels like a tiny piece of modern art, bold yet effortlessly wearable.

products.name: Red Marble Swirl
products.description: Bold crimson nails swirled with creamy white and soft lavender for a hand-mixed marble effect, each tip uniquely veined under a high-gloss finish. A striking, painterly look that feels both artful and effortlessly elegant.

products.name: Red Poppy Folk Art
products.description: A playful mixed set blending vivid red poppy blooms, black folk-style florals, and delicate snowflake accents over soft cream bases. Each nail carries its own hand-painted motif for an artful, one-of-a-kind statement.

products.name: Abstract Picasso Faces
products.description: A bold, artful set of short square nails where each finger tells its own story — hand-painted line-art faces in the spirit of Picasso, swirls of blue marble, a delicate white botanical leaf, and a vivid solid orange tip. Playful color blocking in yellow, navy, and coral makes this a true wearable-art statement.

products.name: Terracotta Folk Floral
products.description: Each nail is hand-painted in warm terracotta, rust, and cream tones with intricate folk-art florals and ornamental line work in red, blue, and gold accents. A glossy finish and short squared shape give this artisanal set a cozy, storybook elegance, with every nail a unique miniature painting.

products.name: Nude Glaze Pop-Art
products.description: A warm peachy-nude set with a high-gloss glaze finish on short squoval tips, accented by two hand-painted pop-art nails in playful abstract color. Effortlessly everyday with a bold, artistic twist.

products.name: Black Polka Dot
products.description: Creamy milk-white nails scattered with hand-painted black dots in varying sizes for a playful yet refined polka-dot effect. The soft semi-sheer base and glossy finish keep this monochrome design clean, elegant, and effortlessly chic.

products.name: Earth & Sky Abstract
products.description: Short rounded press-ons hand-painted with a freeform abstract design, blending sky blue, terracotta rust, cream, and golden-amber swirls like a sunlit desert landscape. The glossy finish lends each wearable miniature canvas a soft, painterly glow.

products.name: Blue Shimmer Red Web
products.description: Shimmering sky-blue tips are hand-painted with bold abstract red lines that web across each nail for a striking, gallery-worthy contrast. Short and square, this art set pairs playful color with a glossy, polished finish.

products.name: Sunset Orange Abstract
products.description: A bold orange press-on with a high-gloss finish, accented by an abstract corner of navy, red, and burgundy brushstrokes. The short squoval shape and vivid color play make this a striking, art-forward statement.

products.name: Green Marble Confetti
products.description: A glossy green marbled base swirls with creamy white, accented by hand-painted silver wave lines and tiny multicolored confetti dots. Playful yet refined, this short square set brings artful texture to an everyday look.

products.name: Glossy Jewel-Tone Square
products.description: A glossy multi-color set spanning sage green, lavender, terracotta, deep red, navy, cream, and black for a playful yet refined look. The clean square tips and high-shine finish make this jewel-toned palette feel modern and effortlessly chic.

products.name: Teal Coral Abstract
products.description: A hand-painted set where swirls of turquoise, coral red, and soft peach blend into a free-form abstract canvas across every nail. Glossy and artful, it reads like wearable watercolor for those who want their tips to be the statement.

products.name: Black Abalone Swirl
products.description: Glossy jet-black nails come alive with iridescent abalone shell inlays and delicate silver-white brushstroke swirls. A dramatic, gallery-worthy design where every nail catches the light in shifting shades of pearl, blue and violet.

products.name: Painted Porcelain Botanicals
products.description: A whimsical mismatched set where each nail tells its own story, from cobalt blue-and-white porcelain brushwork to dried-flower accents pressed into soft yellow and sage tones. Hand-painted skies, speckled lilac, and delicate linework make this an artful, one-of-a-kind statement.

products.name: Jelly Rainbow Gloss
products.description: A playful set of long press-ons in a glossy jelly finish, each tip a different translucent hue — from inky black and deep burgundy to lilac, sage, orange, and lime. The candy-like shine and rainbow palette make this set a bold, joyful statement.

products.name: Red Cat & House
products.description: A playful red-and-white set hand-painted with whimsical motifs — a curled cat, a tiny house, swirls, and bold polka dots. Glossy and charming, it pairs storybook illustration with a clean graphic palette for a design that feels both cozy and bold.

products.name: Black & White Abstract
products.description: A graphic black-and-white set pairing glossy jet-black tips with creamy milk-white nails and hand-painted abstract swirls and lines. The high-shine finish and bold monochrome contrast make it a striking, modern statement.

products.name: Nude 3D Gold Accent
products.description: Soft nude press-on nails in a short square shape with a smooth glossy finish, accented by sculpted 3D embellishments featuring a deep blue gemstone and molten gold detailing. An understated, elegant base elevated by an artful touch of texture and shine.

products.name: Liquid Silver Drip
products.description: Glossy milky-white almond nails accented with hand-placed liquid silver chrome that melts down from the cuticle for a sculptural, molten finish. A minimalist 3D design where cool metallic droplets meet a soft pearl base for understated, modern edge.

products.name: Molten Gold Baroque
products.description: Sculpted nails draped in glossy molten gold foil and set with glinting crystal gems for an opulent, jewelry-inspired finish. A bold baroque statement that turns each fingertip into a wearable piece of art.

products.name: Milky White 3D Floral
products.description: Soft milky white press-ons in a short square shape with a glossy finish, accented by a delicate 3D sculpted flower and a scatter of clear crystals near the cuticle. A quietly elegant, bridal-leaning set that pairs minimalist nudes with refined hand-built detail.

products.name: Black Gold-Leaf 3D
products.description: Deep glossy black nails hand-finished with shimmering gold-leaf accents, anchored by a sculptural 3D statement nail layered in gilded textured detail. A dramatic, couture-inspired set that pairs midnight darkness with the warmth of gold for an unmistakably bold look.

products.name: Silver Chrome Foil
products.description: High-shine silver mirror chrome nails paired with sculptural accent tips of crumpled metallic foil and polished ball studs. A bold, futuristic 3D set that catches the light from every angle.

products.name: Gilded Stone Gemstone
products.description: Long stiletto nails in a smoky gray stone-marble finish, each framed with raised gold-leaf borders and set with embedded gemstone and pearl accents. A sculptural, ornate design that feels like wearable jewelry.

products.name: Red Bloom Chrome Mix
products.description: A playful 3D set blending red floral accents, glossy emerald and teal swirls, and warm copper chrome shimmer for a bold, eclectic statement. Sculpted textures and a glistening rhinestone detail give each nail its own handcrafted character.

products.name: Milky Sage 3D Floral
products.description: Milky white and soft sage almond nails sculpted with dimensional 3D petals, scattered gold-foil flecks, and a pearlescent abalone-shell accent. Delicate iridescent dots add a quiet shimmer to this glossy, garden-inspired set.

products.name: Gold-Leaf Milky Stone
products.description: A clear stiletto nail crowned with a raised milky-white centerpiece, framed in delicate hand-applied gold leaf for a sculptural, jewel-like finish. This 3D design feels artisanal and elegant, like a tiny pebble of opal set in gold.

products.name: Sapphire Orb Gold
products.description: A sculptural 3D press-on featuring a translucent sapphire-blue orb cradled by hand-molded gold metallic accents that twist around the stone like liquid metal. A bold, jewelry-inspired statement piece for those who want their nails to feel like wearable art.

products.name: Sapphire 3D Frame
products.description: A bold sapphire-blue core shimmers at the heart of each nail, framed by a raised, glass-clear gel border that lends the design a sculptural, three-dimensional depth. The metallic shimmer catches the light for a jewel-like, statement finish.

products.name: Silver Foil Bloom
products.description: Glossy dove-gray nails crowned with hand-sculpted silver foil blossoms that ripple like crushed metal petals. A sculptural 3D statement that pairs soft neutral polish with bold, light-catching texture.

products.name: Gemstone Mix Stones
products.description: A playful mismatched set where every nail becomes its own polished gemstone, from deep navy marble and milky cream to silver foil, magenta jelly, and sparkling amber. Each tip carries a glossy, rounded stone-like finish for an eclectic, collector's-treasure feel.

products.name: Gold Charm Glitter
products.description: Long sculpted nails drenched in warm gold glitter and flake, crowned with ornate metallic charms and coin-like jewels for a maximalist, opulent statement. Bold and luxurious, this set turns every gesture into a glint of gold.

products.name: Red Gothic Charm
products.description: Glossy crimson and smoky-white nails dressed in dark metallic charms, spider-web motifs, and edgy gothic embellishments. A daring, statement-making set that fuses Korean-inspired drama with rebellious 3D detailing.

products.name: Milky Pink Square
products.description: A soft milky-pink jelly finish in a short square shape, with a glossy translucent glow that mimics a fresh, healthy natural manicure. Understated and clean, this Korean-inspired set delivers a polished everyday look with a delicate rosy tint.

products.name: Glossy Cherry Squoval
products.description: A deep cherry-red set with a high-gloss finish that catches the light for a polished, lacquered look. The short squoval shape keeps it understated and elegant, perfect for everyday wear with a touch of bold color.

products.name: Dark Cherry Coffin
products.description: A deep, glossy cherry-black shade that shifts to warm burgundy in the light, set on a sleek coffin silhouette. The mirror-bright finish lends these press-ons a rich, vampy elegance for a bold yet refined look.

products.name: Slate Blue Gloss
products.description: A set of press-on nails in a muted dusty blue-gray with a smooth glossy finish. The understated slate tone feels calm and refined, perfect for a polished everyday look.

products.name: Silver Chrome Mirror
products.description: A sleek set of silver chrome press-ons with a liquid-metal mirror finish that catches the light from every angle. The short squared shape keeps the look polished and modern, perfect for an effortlessly futuristic statement.

products.name: Glossy Black Squoval
products.description: A timeless set of deep jet-black press-ons finished with a mirror-bright gloss that catches the light from every angle. The short squoval shape keeps the look clean and effortlessly polished for everyday elegance.

products.name: Classic White French
products.description: A timeless French manicure with a soft peachy-nude base and crisp white tips, finished in a high-gloss shine. The clean, understated look pairs effortlessly with any occasion for an elegant everyday wear.

products.name: Glossy Orange & Black Coffin
products.description: A bold two-tone set pairing vivid glossy orange with deep jet-black nails in a sleek tapered coffin silhouette. The high-shine finish keeps each color clean and striking for a confident, statement-making look.

products.name: Glossy Red Squoval
products.description: A bold set of press-on nails in vivid scarlet red with a high-gloss finish and a clean squoval shape. Classic and confident, this timeless red elevates any look from everyday polish to statement-making elegance.

products.name: Pearl White Square
products.description: Short squared press-ons wrapped in a luminous pearl-white finish that shimmers with a soft opalescent glow. A clean, understated set that pairs everyday wearability with a quietly elegant sheen.

products.name: Glossy Deep Navy
products.description: A rich, deep navy nail finished with a high-gloss shine that catches the light for an understated, sophisticated look. The clean squared silhouette keeps the design effortlessly elegant and versatile for any occasion.

products.name: Glossy Coral-Red Square
products.description: A vivid coral-red set in a clean square shape with a high-gloss, glassy finish. The bold solid color and short length make it a punchy yet polished everyday statement.

products.name: Glossy Wine Almond
products.description: Long almond nails drenched in a deep wine-red gloss that catches the light with mirror-like shine. A rich, sultry shade that feels both timeless and effortlessly bold.
